summary: ServeSync iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (POST /auth/verify for all 3 roles + wrong-password 401 + invalid role 422; categories CRUD incl. duplicate-idempotent, empty-400, cascade-delete-items, 404; menu category-required, invalid tag rejected, category filter, seed items have category+tag; orders lifecycle regression). Frontend: role selection shows 3 cards; wrong Admin password shows 'Incorrect password'; correct password navigates to /admin. Admin has 3 tabs (Categories, Items, Orders), Categories add works & appears in list, Items tab has chips + FAB + bottom-sheet form with photo picker + name + price + tag (None/Must Buy/Most Selling), created item appears immediately with tag pill. Admin Orders shows same orders list with filter chips. Master has only 2 tabs (Menu + Orders) — master-tab-manage is NOT rendered. Master menu is a list view, category chips incl. 'All' visible, MUST BUY and MOST SELLING tag pills render next to item names, ADD → sticky cart → open cart → cart-table-input → place-order-btn navigates to /master/orders. Chef login works, Pending screen shows the freshly placed order with Start Preparing. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native Web console warnings detected: 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation (carry-over from iteration 1).

issues: Items without a real image_base64 all fall back to the same Unsplash placeholder (photo-1504674900247-0877df9cc836). Cosmetic – same finding as iteration 1.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses props.pointerEvents='box-none' – deprecated on RN Web (console warning). Reference: /app/frontend/app/master/index.tsx:284. Move to style.pointerEvents.
'shadow*' style props are deprecated on RN Web (console warning). Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Migrate to boxShadow for web parity.

action_items: (NIT) In /app/frontend/app/master/index.tsx line 284, replace `pointerEvents="box-none"` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
(NIT) In /app/frontend/src/theme.ts, migrate shadow.* (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) usage to `boxShadow` for RN Web parity.
(LOW) Optional: seed unique placeholder images per item so master menu cards don't all look identical when image_base64 is null.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: MenuItemCreate declares `category: str` as required, so missing category returns 422 (pydantic) — acceptable. Empty/whitespace category is separately caught with 400. Good.

server.py: /auth/verify compares plaintext passwords from env — acceptable for the requested role gate; passwords are never returned to clients. ROLE_PASSWORDS dict is built at import time from env, so backend restart is required after changing .env.

server.py: `delete_category` cascades correctly (delete_many on menu_items by category name). Note: cascade is by category NAME, not id — if a category is ever renamed in the future, orphan items would result. Not an issue today since categories are immutable in current API.
server.py cleanly excludes _id via projection={'_id': 0} everywhere.
admin/items.tsx: uses `mediaTypes: ['images']` (new array API) — correct for latest expo-image-picker (MediaType.Images deprecated in previous SDKs). Good.
api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly with no fallback.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created + cleaned up TEST_Desserts, TEST_CASCADE + item, TEST_TaggedItem. UI test created TEST_UI_Cat, TEST_UI_TaggedItem — both cleaned up via API at end of run. No leftover TEST_ data in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 27 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_servesync.py are the current regression suite (covers auth/verify, categories CRUD+cascade, menu with tag+category filter, orders lifecycle). New testIDs added in iteration 2: role-{admin|master|chef}-card, role-password-input, role-password-submit, admin-tab-{categories|items|orders}, cat-name-input, cat-add-btn, cat-row-<id>, cat-delete-<id>, admin-cat-chip-<name>, admin-add-item-fab, admin-item-name-input, admin-item-price-input, admin-pick-image-btn, admin-tag-{none|must-buy|most-selling}, admin-save-item-btn, admin-item-<id>, admin-item-delete-<id>, cat-chip-<name> (master), master-tab-{menu|orders}. Note: submit/save buttons at the bottom of RN Web modals may report 'element outside viewport' with page.click(); use handle.evaluate('el => el.click()') to bypass Playwright's viewport check. This is not a real UI bug — buttons work fine for real users.
rca_of_issue: N/A – no functional bugs. Only two RN Web deprecation warnings carried over from iteration 1.
